text_attribute.text: The 15 Day Cleanse is formulated to promote gut health and may relieve discomfort, leaving you feeling lighter and energized from within.
Benefits:
Supports Regularity: The 15 day cleanse gut support formula may help promote healthy bowel movements and regularity, reducing discomfort and promoting digestive well-being.
Reduces Bloating & Discomfort: By addressing occasional constipation, these colon pills can help alleviate bloating and discomfort, leaving you feeling lighter and more energized.
Gentle & Effective: The natural formula of herbal pills works gently to cleanse your digestive system, avoiding harshness or discomfort.
Promotes Gut Health: By encouraging regularity, the cleanse pill can contribute to a healthier digestive environment.
Easy to Use: Convenient capsule format allows for easy integration into your daily routine.
Fast-Acting: Feel the difference within 12-24 hours, allowing you to experience the benefits quickly.
What does the pack contain?
Each pack of 15 Day Cleanse contains 30 capsules, carefully formulated to deliver maximum benefits.
How to use it?
Start with one pill, observe the effect and increase to two pills if needed. Take daily (or as needed) up to 15 days. Do not repeat until 6-8 weeks to allow your gut to rest.
This product is not intended for pregnant or nursing mothers or childern under the age of 18.
Contain licorice - In case of high blood pressure, excessive consumption of this product should be avoided.

MilaMiAmor products are made in an FDA-registered, approved, inspected state-of-the-art facility, with strict adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). Each and Every batch is 3rd Party Tested for Quality, Purity, and Potency. MilaMiAmor is committed to supporting your well-being with premium products.
